entities.name: Kiichirō Toyoda
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Kiichiro Toyoda  was a Japanese engineer and businessman, and the son of Toyoda Loom Works founder Sakichi Toyoda. His decision to change Toyoda's focus from automatic loom manufacture into automobile manufacturing created what later became Toyota.
